metadata.summary: The customer ordered a medium hot coffee and the agent began to ask about milk preferences before the call ended abruptly.

messages.text: Hello Jutin Welcome to manhattan bagel It is great to see you again What would you like to order?
I want a hot coffee, medium size. Hello?
Okay, one medium hot coffee. Now, for your coffee, would you like to add any milk? We have regular milk, skim, half and half, almond, oat, and soy.
